cohort: 100 pregnant women with fetal uterine death as per WHO definition (fetal death occurring after 22 weeks of pregnancy or 500 g birth weight if the term is unknown or corrected).
finding: The main cause of in utero fetal death was hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, followed by unknown causes, potentially related to economic or cultural reasons limiting autopsy and placental examination.
mod_finding: 96% of the pregnant women gave birth naturally and 4% delivered by caesarean section.
